name: profusion
short_description: Python library implementing standard, counting, scalable, and memory-mapped Bloom filter data structures.
long_description: Profusion is a Python library that implements multiple variants of Bloom filters, probabilistic data structures optimized for space-efficient storage and querying of large datasets. The library provides four main implementations: a standard Bloom filter for basic membership testing, a counting Bloom filter for element frequency tracking, a scalable Bloom filter that dynamically grows as more elements are added, and a memory-mapped counting Bloom filter that uses file-backed storage for persistence. Bloom filters trade accuracy for space by using multiple hash functions to map elements to bit arrays, allowing for very fast lookups with a tunable false positive rate. These filters are commonly used in caching systems, spam detection, network routing, and other scenarios where space-efficient membership testing is valuable.

modules.description: Package initialization and exports for Bloom, CountingBloom, ScalableBloom, and MMCountingBloom classes with version and program metadata.
Standard Bloom filter implementation with configurable capacity and error ratio, supporting add/check operations, persistence via ZIP files, and saturation tracking.
Counting Bloom filter extending standard Bloom to track element frequencies using binned counters instead of single bits, with frequency-based threshold checking.
Scalable Bloom filter that automatically creates new internal filters as element count exceeds capacity thresholds, supporting unlimited growth with error decay.
Memory-mapped counting Bloom filter using file-backed storage in /dev/shm for persistence and concurrent access with file-based locking mechanisms.
Unit tests for standard Bloom filter covering initialization, element addition/checking, file persistence, and saturation metrics.
Unit tests for counting Bloom filter validating frequency tracking, threshold checking, element addition, and persistence functionality.
Unit tests for scalable Bloom filter verifying dynamic growth behavior, multi-filter operations, element checking, and persistence.
Unit tests for memory-mapped counting Bloom filter testing file-backed storage, concurrent access patterns, and data persistence across instances.
Package configuration defining project metadata, dependencies (mmh3), installation requirements, and distribution settings.
